author: reek
body: A type variable in a signature is universally quantified: the caller chooses it, so the body must answer every choice. This body answers one.

author: reek
body: In h the variable b is the one that matters: it appears in no parameter, so it is free at both ends and the body decides it in the RETURN.

author: reek
body: The rule is not about return position, and f is here to say so. Its signature promises to accept any a and answer an Integer, but the body adds one to a, which only an Integer can do. The body decides a through a PARAMETER, the promise is false in the same way, and the diagnostic is the same. Both defs raise CDX2087; the sidecar names the code once.
